title: 四柱命盘
caption: 以日干庚金为参照。年、月、日、时各自保留干支与藏干，柱位之间既有联系，也有不同的读取作用；这里不把四柱替换成固定年龄区间。日柱强调自我参照，四柱一起构成后续图表的原局基础。
captionEn: The four pillars and their hidden stems preserve source position. Geng is the Day Master. Positions support later interpretation without fixed age bands.

title: 五行结构
caption: 数字来自四个天干、四个地支及十个藏干的未加权清单，共十八项。同一个字在不同位置出现会分别计入；这些数量让结构可见，却不是能量百分比、强弱评分或五行喜忌。强弱仍读取已接受的完整结构结论。
captionEn: Counts cover four stems, four branches and ten hidden stems: eighteen unweighted entries. They are an inventory, not energy percentages or a strength score.

title: 十神结构
caption: 以庚日主为参照，统计已提供的其余三个天干与十个藏干，共十三项。日主自身不计入十神数量。零表示该清单没有相应记录，不代表一生没有此类作用；这里不增加运年十神，也不据数量单独决定职业、财富或关系。
captionEn: The ten-god inventory covers three other visible stems and ten hidden stems. The Day Master itself is excluded. Zero denotes no entry in this inventory, not absence throughout life.

title: 季节与日主
caption: 子月的水势与三庚的判断一起读取，最终结构判断仍为中和偏弱。土的承载与金的边界保留为主辅条件；火有冬令调候与责任的作用。图示不以季节或三合单独改写强弱，也不把调候候选与用神层混为一谈。
captionEn: Zi winter context, Geng judgment and Water output are read together. Strength remains moderately weak; Earth carries, Metal assists, and Fire retains warmth and responsibility.

title: 原局支系关系
caption: 申、子、辰的三合关系与寅申冲同时保留。三合的存在不表示已经完成化水，冲也不取消合。不同线型标示联系与张力，而不是关系强度；两种作用共同参与原局的理解、变化与方向选择。
group: 申子辰三合关系成立 · 未确认化水
captionEn: The Shen–Zi–Chen configuration and Yin–Shen clash remain together. Combination does not erase clash or establish complete Water transformation.

title: 三庚、水势与财星
caption: 三庚并见保留庚金的判断与边界，子月及申子辰水势使食伤表达突出，甲木偏财把输出接到现实价值。寅申冲保留方向张力；中和偏弱的判断要求以土承载、以金辅助，而非只增加输出。
captionEn: Three Geng stems emphasize judgment and boundaries. Zi month and the Shen–Zi–Chen water configuration support expression through the Output stars; Jia Indirect Wealth connects output with practical value. Yin–Shen tension remains. The moderately weak reading calls for Earth support and Metal assistance.

title: 人生结构与运行方式
caption: 进入一个环境以后，你可能先理解规则，再承担责任，逐渐积累可用的方法与资源。阶段完成不必等于失败；当原来的安排不能容纳新的发展，重构可以延续已有基础，而不是把所有积累推倒。
captionEn: You may enter an environment, learn its rules, take responsibility and accumulate methods and resources. Completing a stage need not mean failure. Reorganization can carry useful foundations forward when an earlier arrangement no longer holds the next development.
titleEn: Life Structure & Operating Pattern · In practice

title: 食伤生财的专业路径
caption: 庚金生食伤水，水再接甲木偏财；子中癸伤官当令、申中壬食神及辰中癸伤官提供输出来源。丙七杀藏寅带入责任，三庚保留自主判断，土金承载决定价值链能否持续，而非保证职位提升。
captionEn: Geng Metal feeds Water Output, which connects with Jia Indirect Wealth. Gui Hurting Officer in Zi and Chen, and Ren Eating God in Shen, supply the output pathway. Bing Seven Killings hidden in Yin adds responsibility. Judgment and Earth–Metal support condition continuity.

title: 偏财、正财与承载
caption: 甲木偏财透月，乙木正财藏辰，显示机会流动与持续安排两类线索。三庚比肩让资源互动与自主边界进入读取，辰土提供承载与储存的解释意象。收入必须经过成本、责任和留存条件，不能直接等同财富。
captionEn: Jia Indirect Wealth is exposed on the month stem; Yi Direct Wealth is hidden in Chen. Opportunity and continuity are distinct lenses. Three Geng Peer stars introduce resource interaction and boundaries; Chen offers a carrying and storage metaphor. Income is not automatically retained wealth.

title: 财星、日支与关系结构
caption: 甲木财星、日支辰、三庚判断与寅申冲共同提供关系读取线索。财星涉及现实连接，日支强调共同生活的承载，三庚保留自主边界，冲的张力使方向协调可见；这些线索不用于指定伴侣或断定关系结果。
captionEn: Jia Wealth, the Chen day branch, three Geng stems and Yin–Shen tension anchor the relationship reading. They connect practical involvement, shared-life carrying, autonomy and direction. These lenses neither identify a destined partner nor determine a relationship outcome.

title: 家庭与支持系统
caption: 能处理问题的人，往往也更容易被交付更多责任。家庭支持要落实为谁处理事务、谁提供资源、谁承担照顾；可靠的分担同时保留各自发展空间，避免所有需要继续汇集到同一个人身上。
captionEn: Someone who solves problems may also receive more responsibility. Family support becomes tangible through handling tasks, providing resources and sharing care. Dependable support preserves development space rather than concentrating every need on one person.

title: 输出、负荷与承载
caption: 三庚的撑持、水势的理解输出与寅申冲的方向张力，使能力与负荷同时进入读取。中和偏弱保留承载条件，土提供基础、金提供边界。此处观察输入、责任与恢复怎样连接，不以五行或冲刑害作医学诊断。
captionEn: Three Geng stems, water expression and Yin–Shen direction tension keep capability and load in view together. The moderately weak reading retains carrying conditions: Earth foundations and Metal boundaries. These are lenses on responsibility and recovery, not medical diagnosis.

title: 长期周期与转折模式
caption: 建立让基础逐渐可靠，扩张让成果进入更大范围，筛选让资源回到值得继续的部分，重组则为再建立创造条件。循环可以回访，也可以局部发生；它帮助理解阶段变化，不指定哪年或哪岁必须转折。
captionEn: Building develops foundations; expansion extends results; selection returns resources to what merits continuation; reorganization enables renewed building. The cycle can recur or apply to one domain, without assigning a year or age to a transition.

title: 原局、大运与年度
caption: 原局庚申／甲子／庚辰／庚寅叠加己巳大运与丙寅年度。甲己仅论合，巳申六合兼破、巳寅害及寅巳申刑并存；年度寅重复原局寅、冲申并害巳。年份、年龄与起运未明确，不补写。
captionEn: The natal Geng–Shen / Jia–Zi / Geng–Chen / Geng–Yin chart is overlaid by Ji–Si Da Yun and Bing–Yin annual pillars. Jia–Ji combines without an Earth transformation conclusion. Si–Shen combination and break, harms, punishment, repeated Yin and Yin–Shen clash coexist. Unspecified dates and ages stay unspecified.

title: 当前激活关系
caption: 原局庚申／甲子／庚辰／庚寅叠加己巳大运与丙寅年度。甲己仅论合，巳申六合兼破、巳寅害及寅巳申刑并存；年度寅重复原局寅、冲申并害巳。年份、年龄与起运未明确，不补写。
group: 寅巳申刑：原局寅 × 大运巳 × 原局申
captionEn: The natal Geng–Shen / Jia–Zi / Geng–Chen / Geng–Yin chart is overlaid by Ji–Si Da Yun and Bing–Yin annual pillars. Jia–Ji combines without an Earth transformation conclusion. Si–Shen combination and break, harms, punishment, repeated Yin and Yin–Shen clash coexist. Unspecified dates and ages stay unspecified.

title: 让敏锐进入稳定结构
caption: 在工作讨论里，你可能先发现方案的漏洞，再理解各方需求，最后把分散的信息重组成可用的方法。判断、理解、重组与落地不是性格分数，而是三庚、水势、财星与承载条件共同形成的观察路径。
captionEn: In a work discussion, you may notice a weakness, understand competing needs, then reorganize scattered information into a useful method. Judgment, understanding, reorganization and implementation describe an interpretive pathway, rather than personality scores.

title: 四柱的人生位置
caption: 年柱庚申、月柱甲子、日柱庚辰与时柱庚寅分别提供起点、社会现实、自我位置与后续方向的观察线索。申子辰三合条件与寅申冲同时保留，稳定与重构并存，不把柱位换算为固定年龄。
captionEn: Geng–Shen, Jia–Zi, Geng–Chen and Geng–Yin provide lenses on origins, social reality, self-position and later direction. The Shen–Zi–Chen configuration and Yin–Shen clash coexist, linking stability and reorganization without assigning fixed ages to pillar positions.

title: 责任、权限与资源
caption: 专业认知经过可用方案、客户或组织采用，才能形成可重复的价值。责任增加时，需要同步理解权限、资源与结果的关系；否则方法仍可能困在一个人的忙碌里，难以成为可靠的交付结构。
captionEn: Professional cognition becomes repeatable value through usable solutions and adoption by customers or organizations. Greater responsibility also needs authority, resources and results to align; otherwise useful methods can remain trapped in one person’s workload.

title: 从个人能力到可重复结构
caption: 专业认知经过可用方案、客户或组织采用，才能形成可重复的价值。责任增加时，需要同步理解权限、资源与结果的关系；否则方法仍可能困在一个人的忙碌里，难以成为可靠的交付结构。
captionEn: Professional cognition becomes repeatable value through usable solutions and adoption by customers or organizations. Greater responsibility also needs authority, resources and results to align; otherwise useful methods can remain trapped in one person’s workload.

title: 资源的三个层次
caption: 收入经过留存、配置与持久资源，才逐渐形成选择空间。外部机会越多，越要辨认时间、成本和责任如何影响留下来的部分；图示呈现条件之间的联系，不提供投资产品、回报率或资产估值。
captionEn: Income passes through retention, allocation and durable resources before expanding choice. Opportunities also consume time, cost and responsibility. The diagram shows these conditions; it does not prescribe investments, returns or asset values.

title: 机会与留存条件
caption: 收入经过留存、配置与持久资源，才逐渐形成选择空间。外部机会越多，越要辨认时间、成本和责任如何影响留下来的部分；图示呈现条件之间的联系，不提供投资产品、回报率或资产估值。
captionEn: Income passes through retention, allocation and durable resources before expanding choice. Opportunities also consume time, cost and responsibility. The diagram shows these conditions; it does not prescribe investments, returns or asset values.

title: 吸引与长期结构
caption: 吸引让彼此靠近，一致行动让信任积累，边界让共同生活保持清楚。短期好感与长期标准并不相同；压力出现时能否回应、承诺能否兑现，以及未来安排怎样共同承担，才让关系逐渐进入现实。
captionEn: Attraction brings people closer; consistent action builds trust; boundaries clarify shared life. Initial chemistry and long-term criteria differ. Responsiveness under pressure, fulfilled commitments and shared future arrangements make the relationship practical.

title: 年、日、时的家庭位置
caption: 年柱庚申提供早期秩序的线索，日支辰涉及共同生活承载，时柱庚寅保留后续方向；寅申冲让前后位置的张力可见。家庭图用角色表达资源与照顾分配，不把柱位解释成固定年龄，也不假设你已有伴侣或子女。
captionEn: Geng–Shen offers an early-order lens, Chen concerns shared-life carrying, and Geng–Yin retains later direction. Yin–Shen tension connects these positions. The family map depicts roles and support; it assumes neither fixed ages nor an existing partner or children.

title: 负荷与恢复的循环
caption: 信息输入与责任累积可能持续占用理解和判断；外部仍能交付，不代表内部还有同样多的余量。支持进入、重新定界与恢复空间，让负荷回到可承载范围，而不是把每次放慢都解释为能力下降。
captionEn: Information and responsibility may continuously occupy understanding and judgment. Continuing to deliver does not prove that internal capacity is unchanged. Support, renewed boundaries and recovery space can make the load manageable without treating slower movement as lost ability.

title: 五行功能与转折条件
caption: 土承载、金定界、水理解输出、木连接资源、火调候并带入责任，是本盘保留的功能角色。寅申冲与三合水势并存，使积累和转向可以同时发生；这些作用不构成木火土金水的必经年代顺序。
captionEn: Earth carries, Metal sets boundaries, Water understands and expresses, Wood connects resources, and Fire brings seasonal warmth and responsibility. Yin–Shen tension coexists with the water configuration. These functions do not form an inevitable sequence of life periods.

title: 当前的三个强调
caption: 己土正印把支撑系统带到前面，丙寅同时强调责任与方向。机会、要求和基础需要一起理解；重新定界与逐步调整，可能比单纯加快更贴近当前结构，但不能由此断定某件事情必然发生。
captionEn: Ji Earth Direct Resource brings support systems forward; Bing–Yin emphasizes responsibility and direction. Opportunities, demands and foundations need to be read together. Clearer boundaries and gradual adjustment may fit this structure better than speed alone, without guaranteeing an event.

title: 贯穿全文的运行结构
caption: 判断与理解形成能力，输出要经过现实采用才成为价值；关系、家庭和恢复空间又决定这些成果能否长期承载。周期与时序补充方向上的变化。它们是可以与你生活对照的结构，而不是分数、人物分类或预定事件。
captionEn: Judgment and understanding form capability. Output becomes value through adoption. Relationships, family and recovery condition sustained carrying; cycles and timing add changing direction. Compare these connected patterns with your life, rather than treating them as scores or predetermined events.

title: 你的命盘，一眼看见
caption: 三庚、子月、水势与甲木，共同参与判断、理解、输出和现实价值的读取。中和偏弱结论要求保留承载条件；己巳与丙寅只是目前提供的时序层。各图分别展开事实与解释，不把任何单一特征当成完整的人生结论。
captionEn: Geng judgment, Water expression and Jia Wealth connect understanding with practical value. Earth and Metal carrying conditions remain; current timing is Ji–Si with Bing–Yin.
